productionModulesExtended.notes: Extends reducer-route vocabulary and route-event emission for after-hit interrupt selection, pending attack damage additions, timed active-effect turn boundaries, escape ability-check cleanup, and illumination concentration cleanup. The events are derived from typed runtime procedure/fill/active-effect shape and state deltas, not authored spell identity.
Extends spellTurnStartDamageAndSave with an explicit source fact so generic turn-boundary damage/save effects cannot be routed as after-hit timed damage riders.
Extends AttackSpellDamageAddition with sourceProcedure so weapon-attack damage routes can distinguish after-hit rider additions from other spell-hosted weapon damage additions.

expectedNextReuse.notes: Future selected after-hit spell identity tasks should reuse the generic public after-hit reducer observations instead of introducing selected-spell route dispatch or a whole-battle rider accumulator.

completion.notes: Task 3 observes copied qRoute for after-hit damage rider owner surfaces through exact public battle reducer routeEvents. BattleState owners cover interrupt decisions, spell-slot/action-economy and feature free-cast spends, Hit Point damage, save-gated condition lifecycle, Concentration, timed active Spell Effect cleanup, escape Ability Check cleanup, and illumination active-effect cleanup. Typed source facts on existing effect/addition projections prevent generic escape and generic turn-boundary routes from being mislabeled as after-hit. No production accumulator or duplicate durable state was added.
